title: sphaeropteris robinsonii
intro: Sphaeropteris robinsonii, commonly known as the Robinson's tree fern, is a species of tree fern that belongs to the family Cyatheaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Sphaeropteris robinsonii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties. By exploiting its bioactive compounds, researchers have been able to isolate and study the specific constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions.
